f.title: Apply long-holiday receipt rules when administrative holidays run 6 or more consecutive days
f.statement: A "long holiday" (長期連休) is a period in which administrative-organ holidays (the days listed in Article 1(1) of the Act on Holidays of Administrative Organs, Act No. 91 of 1988) continue for 6 days or more. The handling of the receipt date and related matters for electronic post-marketing adverse reaction reports and clinical trial adverse reaction reports transmitted during such a period had been set out in the 20 Dec 2019 PMDA five-director joint notice (薬機審マ発第1220001号ほか, "旧連休通知").
f.legal_basis: 行政機関の休日に関する法律（昭和63年法律第91号）第1条第1項
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder / clinical trial sponsor (reporter to PMDA)
rows.quote: 行政機関の休日（「行政機関の休日に関する法律」（昭和 63 年法律第 91 号） 第１条第１項に掲げる日をいう。）が 6 日以上連続する場合（以下「長期連休」という。）、 この間に送信される市販後副作用等報告及び治験副作用等報告の電子的報告の受付日等の取扱いを「6 日間以上の長期連休期間中に送信された副作用等報告の受付日等に係る取扱い等について」（令和元年 12 月 20 日付け薬機審マ発第 1220001 号・薬機安企発第 1220001 号・薬機安対一発第 1220001 号・薬機安対二発第 1220001号・薬機品安発第 1220001 号独立行政法人医薬品医療機器総合機構審査マネジメント部長・安全性情報・企画管理部長・医薬品安全対策第一部長・医薬品安全対策第二部長・医療機器品質管理・安全対策部長連名通知、以下「旧連休通知」という。）によりお示ししてきたところです。
rows.review_note: Review: statement corrected: the quoted passage says the handling was previously shown in the 2019 notice (旧連休通知によりお示ししてきた), not that this sentence sets it; Act number added (昭和63年 = 1988). Mandatory kept as a binding scope definition. Double-check: quote extended to the end of the sentence (によりお示ししてきたところです) so the reference to the 2019 notice is proven; statement no longer claims the sentence itself sets the handling. Below 90: scope definition rather than a duty, actor is the reader not a named duty-bearer, Mandatory a judgement call (cites the Holidays Act only for the holiday definition). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees in meaning (definition of long holiday, 2019 notice as prior source). Statement: dropped the cross-reference 'which this notice replaces (see 0003)', which the quote does not say. Below 90: scope definition, no duty-bearer.
rows.quote_en: Where holidays of administrative organs (meaning the days listed in Article 1(1) of the "Act on Holidays of Administrative Organs" (Act No. 91 of 1988 [Showa 63])) continue for 6 days or more (hereinafter a "long holiday"), the handling of the receipt date etc. of electronic reports of post-marketing adverse reaction reports and clinical trial adverse reaction reports transmitted during that period has been set out in "Handling of the receipt date etc. of adverse reaction reports transmitted during long holiday periods of 6 days or more" (joint notice of the Director of the Office of Review Management, the Director of the Office of Safety Information and Planning Management, the Director of the Office of Pharmaceutical Safety I, the Director of the Office of Pharmaceutical Safety II and the Director of the Office of Medical Device Quality Management and Safety, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency, 薬機審マ発第1220001号・薬機安企発第1220001号・薬機安対一発第1220001号・薬機安対二発第1220001号・薬機品安発第1220001号, dated 20 December 2019 [Reiwa 1]; hereinafter the "former holiday notice").

f.title: Apply the long-holiday handling also to device malfunction and regenerative medicine product reports
f.statement: In view of the growing share of electronic reporting, PMDA applies the handling in this notice, in addition to post-marketing and clinical trial adverse reaction reports, to electronic medical device malfunction reports (receipt dates set by the 31 Jan 2020 PMDA notice 薬機品安発第0131001号) and regenerative medicine product malfunction reports (receipt dates set by the 31 Jan 2020 joint notice 薬機安企発第0131001号・薬機安対二発第0131001号).
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder / clinical trial sponsor (reporter to PMDA)
rows.quote: 今般、電子的報告の割合が増えてきたことも踏まえ、市販後副作用等報告及び治験副作用等報告に加え、次の電子報告についても下記のとおりとすることとしましたので、貴会会員への周知方ご配慮願います。・「医療機器の不具合等報告の留意点について」（令和２年１月 31 日付け薬機品安発第 0131001 号独立行政法人医薬品医療機器総合機構医療機器品質管理・安全対策部長通知、以下「部長通知」という。）により受付日等を示している医療機器の不具合等報告・「再生医療等製品の不具合等報告の留意点について」（令和２年 1 月 31 日付け薬機安企発第 0131001 号・薬機安対二発第 0131001 号独立行政法人医薬品医療機器総合機構安全性情報・企画管理部長・医薬品安全対策第二部長連名通知、以下「二部長連名通知」という。）により受付日等を示している再生医療等製品の不具合報告
rows.review_note: Review: verified scope extension against the Japanese (device malfunction reports per 部長通知 and regenerative medicine product malfunction reports per 二部長連名通知). No change. Double-check: below 90: PMDA's own scope decision (下記のとおりとすることとしました), reporter actor inferred, Mandatory a judgement call; quote includes list bullets. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; scope extension to device and regenerative-product malfunction reports and both notice numbers match. Below 90 kept.
rows.quote_en: In view of, among other things, the increasing proportion of electronic reports, it has now been decided that, in addition to post-marketing adverse reaction reports and clinical trial adverse reaction reports, the following electronic reports shall also be handled as set out below; please take care to inform your members accordingly. - Malfunction and other reports for medical devices for which the receipt date etc. is set out in "Points to note on malfunction and other reports for medical devices" (notice of the Director of the Office of Medical Device Quality Management and Safety, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency, 薬機品安発第0131001号, dated 31 January 2020 [Reiwa 2]; hereinafter the "Director's notice"). - Malfunction reports for regenerative medicine and other products for which the receipt date etc. is set out in "Points to note on malfunction and other reports for regenerative medicine and other products" (joint notice of the Director of the Office of Safety Information and Planning Management and the Director of the Office of Pharmaceutical Safety II, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency, 薬機安企発第0131001号・薬機安対二発第0131001号, dated 31 January 2020; hereinafter the "two-director joint notice").

f.title: Stop applying the 2019 long-holiday notice
f.statement: With the application of this notice, the former long-holiday notice of 20 Dec 2019 (薬機審マ発第1220001号ほか, "旧連休通知") is abolished.
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder / clinical trial sponsor (reporter to PMDA)
rows.quote: なお、本通知の適用に伴い、旧連休通知は廃止します。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: authority-only abolition statement with no company step beyond ceasing to rely on the 2019 notice; Mandatory a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Below 90 kept: authority-only abolition statement.
rows.quote_en: With the application of this notice, the former holiday notice is abolished.

f.title: Telephone PMDA promptly when a holiday-period report was not received, to have it deemed reported on the first business day
f.statement: The receipt status of electronic adverse reaction and malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday is to be checked promptly after the long holiday (the notice does not name who checks). A report then found not to have been received on the first business day after the long holiday, because of a failure of the PMDA electronic data processing system or similar or an unavoidable cause on the reporter side, is deemed reported on the first business day after the long holiday only if the reporter telephones the responsible PMDA department promptly after the non-completion becomes known and then submits the report.
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).
f.exceptions: Only where non-receipt is due to a PMDA system failure or an unavoidable reporter-side cause, and only if the telephone contact precedes the report.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder / clinical trial sponsor (reporter to PMDA)
rows.deadline: Telephone and report promptly (速やかに) after the non-completion becomes known; deemed reported on the first business day after the long holiday
rows.quote: 長期連休期間中に送信された副作用等報告及び不具合等報告の電子的報告の受付状況については、長期連休期間後速やかに確認を行うこととする。その結果、PMDAの電子情報処理組織等の障害又は報告者側のやむを得ない要因により長期連休期間後の第一営業日に受付されず報告未了であることが判明した報告については、報告未了判明後速やかに担当部署に電話連絡をした上で報告された場合に限り、長期連休期間後の第一営業日に報告されたものとみなすこととする。
data_elements: first business day after the long holiday
rows.review_note: Review: removed "PMDA checks": the source (確認を行うこととする) has no stated subject, so the check is left unattributed; deemed-receipt conditions verified against the Japanese (cause = PMDA system failure 等 or reporter-side unavoidable cause; not received on first business day; prompt telephone contact before the report) and kept in exceptions. Mandatory kept as the condition for the deemed date. Double-check: quote proves the conditions and the deemed first-business-day receipt; below 90: the telephone step is a condition for the deemed date (限り...みなす) rather than an express duty, so Mandatory is a judgement call; the checker of receipt status is unnamed; reporter actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; 'shall be checked promptly', the two causes, the first-business-day deeming and the prompt telephone condition all match. Below 90: checker unnamed; telephone step is a deeming condition.
rows.quote_en: The receipt status of electronic reports of adverse reaction reports and malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday shall be checked promptly after the long holiday. As a result, a report that is found not to have been received on the first business day after the long holiday, and therefore not completed, owing to a failure of the PMDA electronic data processing system or similar or to an unavoidable cause on the reporter's side, shall be deemed to have been reported on the first business day after the long holiday only where it is reported after the responsible department has been contacted by telephone promptly after the non-completion of the report becomes known.

f.title: Telephone PMDA promptly after the ACK before sending a follow-up for a case transmitted during a long holiday
f.statement: For cases whose electronic adverse reaction or malfunction report was transmitted during a long holiday, no ACK message is returned until the first business day after the holiday; where a follow-up report on such a case is needed, the follow-up is deemed made on the first business day after the holiday only if the reporter telephones the responsible PMDA department promptly after receiving the ACK and then submits the follow-up report.
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).
f.exceptions: Only if the telephone contact precedes the follow-up report.
f.processes: Submission operations; E2B / transmission; Case processing & follow-up

rows.deadline: Telephone and submit the follow-up promptly (速やかに) after receipt of the ACK; deemed made on the first business day after the long holiday
rows.quote: 長期連休期間中に副作用等報告及び不具合等報告の電子的報告を送信した症例については、長期連休期間後の第一営業日までACKメッセージが返信されないため、当該症例の追加報告が必要な場合であって、ACKメッセージの受信後速やかに担当部署に電話連絡をした上で追加報告が行われた場合に限り、長期連休期間後の第一営業日に追加報告がされたものとみなすこととする。

No change. rows.quote_en: For cases for which an electronic adverse reaction report or malfunction report was transmitted during a long holiday, no ACK message is returned until the first business day after the long holiday; therefore, where a follow-up report on such a case is required, the follow-up report shall be deemed to have been made on the first business day after the long holiday only where it is made after the responsible department has been contacted by telephone promptly after receipt of the ACK message.

f.title: Ask PMDA about adverse reaction reports outside items 1-2 and non-electronic reports sent during long holidays
f.statement: For adverse reaction reports, where anything is unclear about electronic reports not covered by items 1 and 2, or about the receipt-date handling during long holidays of reports other than electronic reports set out in Annex 9 ("副作用等報告の受付について"), section 5 (1), of the 31 Aug 2020 five-director joint PMDA notice on E2B(R3) reporting (五部長連名通知), the reporter is to contact the responsible PMDA department.
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays). Medical device malfunction reports.

f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays). Regenerative medicine product malfunction reports.

rows.quote: 再生医療等製品の不具合等報告のうち、上記 1.及び 2.に該当しない電子的報告並びに二部長連名通知の別添５「不具合等報告の受付について」の５．受付日・送信日の（１）電子的報告以外の報告の長期連休中の受付日等に係る取扱いについて、不明な点がある場合は、担当部署へ問い合わせること。

f.title: For urgent trial safety situations, telephone PMDA and then send the first report by fax
f.statement: Where a clinical trial adverse reaction requires urgent action to protect subjects, such as stopping the trial, stopping dosing or stopping enrolment, the sponsor must telephone the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management, PMDA (審査マネジメント部審査企画課) and then send the first report by fax, as set out in Annex 5 ("即時報告・ファックス報告について") of the five-director joint notice.
f.topic: Urgent clinical trial reports during long holidays
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

rows.deadline: Urgent (早急に対応を必要とする事態): telephone first, then fax the first report
rows.quote: 治験副作用等による治験の中止、投薬の中止や患者の組み入れ中止等、被験者保護のため早急に対応を必要とする事態にあっては、五部長連名通知の別添５「即時報告・ファックス報告について」に示すとおりPMDA審査マネジメント部審査企画課へ電話連絡をした上で第一報をFAXにより送付することが必要となる。
rows.review_note: Review: PMDA unit name translated in full (審査企画課 = Review Planning Division). Mandatory kept although the source says "必要となる" (is necessary): it restates the immediate telephone-plus-fax first-report route of the five-director notice Annex 5 for subject-protection emergencies; double-check against the "necessary = Recommended" rule. Double-check: level Mandatory -> Recommended under the 'necessary = Recommended' rule: the quote says 必要となる and cites only the PMDA five-director joint notice Annex 5, not a binding provision; statement 'must' changed to 'needs to'. Below 90: level is a rule-based judgement call, sponsor actor inferred (quote has no subject). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees ('it is necessary ... to telephone ... and then send the first report by fax' = ことが必要となる). Level Recommended kept only for consistency with the project rule applied across the JP corpus (必要 without a cited binding provision = Recommended); the GUIDE Japanese list does not name 必要, and on plain reading this is a required step, so the level remains a judgement call. Below 90. SME level ruling: 必要 form -> Mandatory (必要がある/必要である/ことが必要となる/記載が必要である in a MHLW/PMDA notice or Q&A states a requirement, read as 'must' like すること; no cited provision needed; level changed Recommended -> Mandatory, statement modal set to 'must').
rows.quote_en: In a situation requiring urgent action to protect subjects, such as discontinuation of a clinical trial, discontinuation of dosing or discontinuation of patient enrolment because of a clinical trial adverse reaction or similar, it is necessary, as shown in Annex 5 "Immediate reports and fax reports" of the five-director joint notice, to contact the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management, PMDA by telephone and then send the first report by fax.

f.title: Check the pre-holiday PMDA notice for the emergency telephone contact and follow PMDA instructions after the call
f.statement: For the urgent trial situation in item 4, the sponsor must check, as appropriate, the telephone contact given in the administrative notice or similar that PMDA issues separately before the long holiday, and after the telephone contact must follow PMDA instructions.
f.topic: Urgent clinical trial reports during long holidays
f.applicability: Original language Japanese. PMDA notice 薬機審マ発第115号ほか (13 Dec 2024) on electronic adverse reaction/malfunction reports transmitted during a long holiday (6 or more consecutive administrative-organ holidays).

Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; '適宜確認すること' and 'PMDAの指示に従うこと' rendered with directive force. Below 90 kept.
